content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IVRI Young Professional-I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: ICAR IVRI Young Professional-I Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Veterinary Research Institute (ICAR IVRI) Regional Station Palampur for filling up contractual positions in Himachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under this notification?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Young Professional-I under the research field, aimed at engaging qualified professionals for project-related scientific and technical activities.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Young Professional-I position as specified in the recruitment advertisement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for ICAR IVRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in, allowing eligible candidates to submit advance bio-data by email and subsequently attend the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 27 October 2026. Candidates must ensure they report on time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in relevant subjects or Diploma holders in relevant Agricultural Sciences, Engineering, or Technology.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Young Professional-I position is set between a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 45 years of age.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Young Professional-I position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 30,000.00 per month.

faq.question: Q9. Where should candidates send their advance application and bio-data?
faq.answer: Candidates are advised to submit scanned copies of their full bio-data along with a recent photograph and testimonials in a single PDF file to Dr. Rinku Sharma via email at [email protected].

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents, a set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, experience certificates, and passport-size photographs to the interview venue.
